titleText: JTF News: PBS NewsHour, UN News
mainText: Israeli and Russian forces were added to a UN blacklist for sexual violence in conflict zones.
Israeli forces crossed the Litani River during a ground offensive in Lebanon.
The World Health Organization chief landed in Congo to address an Ebola outbreak.
NATO and the European Union issued statements regarding Russia after a drone strike on a residential building in Romania.
